cases.purpose: Reject malformed suffixes, NUL truncation, overlong commands/lines/input and empty lists without partial normalized or projected output; retain exact 255-byte command boundary and parser reuse after failure.
cases.oracle: Explicit parser contract: the complete file must validate before any record is published; C-string termination cannot discard bytes from a length-bearing file read. Bounds 4096 bytes/line and 65536 bytes/input, command spec at most 255 bytes.
cases.comparison: Exact status/output classifications; no authority/device or grant coverage.

files.bad-tail.policy:
alice ALL = (root) ALL
alice ALL (root) ALL

cases.script:
[[ $(type -t auth) == builtin ]] || exit 99
LC_ALL=C
for name in tail nul long-command empty-command empty-alias empty-runas long-line input-limit; do
  auth policy-parse "bad-$name.policy" > out 2> err; rc=$?
  [[ ! -s out ]] && empty=yes || empty=no
  [[ -s err ]] && diagnostic=yes || diagnostic=no
  printf '%s status=%s empty=%s diagnostic=%s\n' "$name" "$rc" "$empty" "$diagnostic"
done
for name in tail nul long-command empty-command empty-alias empty-runas long-line input-limit; do
  auth policy-list "bad-$name.policy" > out 2> err; rc=$?
  [[ ! -s out ]] && empty=yes || empty=no
  printf 'list-%s status=%s empty=%s\n' "$name" "$rc" "$empty"
done
auth policy-parse boundary255.policy > out 2> err; rc=$?
[[ -s out ]] && records=yes || records=no
[[ ! -s err ]] && quiet=yes || quiet=no
printf 'boundary255 status=%s records=%s quiet=%s\n' "$rc" "$records" "$quiet"
auth policy-parse valid.policy > out 2> err; rc=$?
[[ -s out ]] && records=yes || records=no
printf 'valid-after-failure status=%s records=%s\n' "$rc" "$records"
cases.stdout:
tail status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
nul status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
long-command status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
empty-command status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
empty-alias status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
empty-runas status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
long-line status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
input-limit status=1 empty=yes diagnostic=yes
list-tail status=1 empty=yes
list-nul status=1 empty=yes
list-long-command status=1 empty=yes
list-empty-command status=1 empty=yes
list-empty-alias status=1 empty=yes
list-empty-runas status=1 empty=yes
list-long-line status=1 empty=yes
list-input-limit status=1 empty=yes
boundary255 status=0 records=yes quiet=yes
valid-after-failure status=0 records=yes
